name: Aarti Drugs Limited
summary: Aarti Drugs Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and marketing of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), pharmaceutical intermediates, specialty chemicals, and formulations in India and internationally.
